description:
哇燕街昔日因“wayang”得名，曾是戏院与美食云集的风情街。街坊蔡美娥忆述，这里以上演华人戏曲的怡园戏院最为著名，后来改建为商场。街上宏伟的同济医院提供免费的中医诊治，周围小贩云集，血蛤与海螺更是难忘的古早滋味。百年白新春茶庄也曾在此营业，店铺最终为道路扩宽而拆除，成为时代变迁的见证。 

Wayang Street, named after the Malay word “wayang,” was once a vibrant lane filled with theatres and food stalls. Ex-resident Chua Mui Ngoh recalls that the famed Ee Hng Theatre dominated the area before later becoming a shopping mall. The grand Thong Chai medical institution, offering free treatment regardless of race or religion, was surrounded by hawkers selling memorable dishes like lightly blanched cockles and sea snails. The century-old Pek Sin Choon tea shop also operated there until its premises were demolished for road widening—marking the transformation of a once–bustling cultural street.

#SG60 #新加坡60
